steps.body: [{"httpRequest": {"path": "/target"}, "httpResponse": {"headers": {"content-type": ["application/json; charset=utf-8"]}, "body": {"type": "JSON", "json": "{\"name\": \"old\", \"a\": 1, \"secret\": \"shh\", \"from\": \"v\", \"keep\": true}"}}}, {"httpRequest": {"path": "/target-combined"}, "httpResponse": {"headers": {"content-type": ["application/json; charset=utf-8"]}, "body": {"type": "JSON", "json": "{\"a\": 1}"}}}, {"httpRequest": {"path": "/target-plain"}, "httpResponse": {"headers": {"content-type": ["text/plain; charset=utf-8"]}, "body": "plain text, not json"}}, {"httpRequest": {"path": "/patch"}, "httpOverrideForwardedRequest": {"requestOverride": {"path": "/target", "headers": {"Host": ["localhost:{{port}}"]}}, "responseModifier": {"jsonPatch": [{"op": "replace", "path": "/name", "value": "new"}, {"op": "add", "path": "/b", "value": 2}, {"op": "remove", "path": "/secret"}, {"op": "move", "from": "/from", "path": "/to"}]}}}, {"httpRequest": {"path": "/mergepatch"}, "httpOverrideForwardedRequest": {"requestOverride": {"path": "/target", "headers": {"Host": ["localhost:{{port}}"]}}, "responseModifier": {"jsonMergePatch": {"name": "new", "keep": null, "extra": true}}}}, {"httpRequest": {"path": "/both"}, "httpOverrideForwardedRequest": {"requestOverride": {"path": "/target-combined", "headers": {"Host": ["localhost:{{port}}"]}}, "responseModifier": {"jsonPatch": [{"op": "add", "path": "/b", "value": 2}], "jsonMergePatch": {"a": 10, "b": null, "c": 3}}}}, {"httpRequest": {"path": "/testfail"}, "httpOverrideForwardedRequest": {"requestOverride": {"path": "/target-combined", "headers": {"Host": ["localhost:{{port}}"]}}, "responseModifier": {"jsonPatch": [{"op": "test", "path": "/a", "value": 999}, {"op": "add", "path": "/b", "value": 2}]}}}, {"httpRequest": {"path": "/nonjson"}, "httpOverrideForwardedRequest": {"requestOverride": {"path": "/target-plain", "headers": {"Host": ["localhost:{{port}}"]}}, "responseModifier": {"jsonPatch": [{"op": "add", "path": "/b", "value": 2}]}}}]

steps.note: jsonPatch: replace/add/remove/move applied to a forwarded JSON response body
jsonMergePatch: set/add fields, null deletes a field, recurses into nested objects
jsonPatch applied before jsonMergePatch when both are present
a failing RFC 6902 test op rejects the whole patch; body left unchanged
a non-JSON forwarded body is left byte-for-byte unchanged by jsonPatch
